caption:
Here's a stat worth repeating.

When breast cancer is caught early, the five-year survival rate is over 99% — per the American Cancer Society.
That number exists because research works.

It's also why 30% of every profit from this brand goes straight to breast cancer research.

Wear it loud — link in bio.
